grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
response-format-schema ::= "{" space response-format-schema-visible-relationships-kv "," space response-format-schema-potential-value-kv "," space response-format-schema-problems-kv "," space response-format-schema-uncertain-kv space "}"
response-format-schema-potential-value ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-potential-value-kv ::= "\"potential_value\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-potential-value
response-format-schema-problems ::= "[" space (response-format-schema-problems-item ("," space response-format-schema-problems-item){0,7})? space "]"
response-format-schema-problems-item ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-problems-kv ::= "\"problems\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-problems
response-format-schema-uncertain ::= "[" space (response-format-schema-uncertain-item ("," space response-format-schema-uncertain-item){0,7})? space "]"
response-format-schema-uncertain-item ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-uncertain-kv ::= "\"uncertain\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-uncertain
response-format-schema-visible-relationships ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-visible-relationships-kv ::= "\"visible_relationships\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-visible-relationships
root ::= response-format-schema
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*

transformation.changed: Defer only sampler string maxLength; retain all complete source schema bytes and SHA binding
transformation.unchanged: JSON types, exact keys, required members, enum, string minLength and every array minItems/maxItems
transformation.method: Deterministic pure-JSON GBNF for only two frozen schemas, using schema member order
transformation.length_scope: Only string maxLength is omitted from sampler GBNF to avoid the installed 6703d7894 repetition parser boundary. String minLength and all array minItems/maxItems remain enforced by this grammar. The complete original schema, text system/prompt and host Pydantic retain every string maximum; overlong responses must be rejected without truncation or repair.
